{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0746","text":"Project Nutmeg – Stakeholder Check-in 🎮
Thursday, 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM
Location: Big Couch Room (3rd floor) / video link in calendar

Hey all! 👋

Figuring it's about time we got everyone in a room together on Nutmeg and took a look at where things are. It's been a busy few weeks and I want to make sure we're all feeling good about the direction before things pick up again.

Rough flow I'm picturing:
- Erik walks us through where the build is at (he's going to share his screen, no prep needed from anyone else)
- Tess gives the art update, same as what went out in Monday's art channel post, just live this time
- Raj covers the QA numbers from last sprint
- Hollis has the marketing timeline refresh
- Then we'll chat about the vertical slice and whether the boss fight stays in for the milestone or gets pushed. Nils and Yara, this part is mostly for you two, so please come with opinions 🙏
- Open floor for anything else!

I blocked the full hour just to be safe, but if we wrap early, even better 😄 Snacks will be in the room, and I think someone mentioned leftover cake from Friday.

If you can't make it, ping me and I'll catch you up after. Super low-key, just want us all on the same page!

Attendees: Erik Pruitt, Tess Moreau, Raj Yamamoto, Hollis Abernathy, Nils Castellano, Yara Nakagawa, Sofia

Thanks friends ✨
Sofia
